summary: Verified admin-only write restriction (backend middleware + frontend gating) and new sidebar submenu / role badge / customizable avatar color. Backend pytest: 21/21 pass. Frontend Playwright: 25/25 assertions pass. All expected user1 mutating endpoints -> 403; user1 GETs -> 200; user1 PUT /api/me/preferences -> 200; admin can still write (PUT /api/hypotheses, POST /api/departments, POST /api/report-templates). UI: user1 sees readonly-notice + hidden add/import/save on Employés/Départements/Hypothèses/Budget/Rapports, no nav-utilisateurs; admin sees all controls + nav-utilisateurs and profile-role-badge/avatar-card work. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 1699 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth/prefs, users, employees, budget, reports, admin-guard middleware).

admin_write_guard uses substring match ADMIN_WRITE_ALLOW set with exact-path equality; consider startswith or explicit list to avoid future path-suffix regressions (e.g., /api/me/preferences/xyz would not be allowed if ever added).

admin_write_guard silently ignores JWT decode errors (except: pass) — a malformed/expired token results in the request passing through the middleware; the actual endpoint still requires auth so it fails downstream, but consider explicit 401 for clarity.
